identity.title: ALMA observations of atomic carbon in z ∼ 4 dusty star-forming galaxies
identity.journal: Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society

paper_type_evidence.quote: We present ALMA ($1-0$) (rest frequency 492 GHz) observations for a sample of 13 strongly-lensed dusty star-forming galaxies originally discovered at 1.4mm in a blank-field survey by the South Pole Telescope.

evidence.quote: Thirteen DSFGs were found to lie at redshifts $3.24 < z < 4.85$, shifting the ($1-0$) into ALMA Band 3.
Thirteen DSFGs were found to lie at redshifts $3.24 < z < 4.85$, shifting the ($1-0$) into ALMA Band 3.

distance_source.value: ALMA Cycle 0 blind redshift search (Weiss et al. 2013)

evidence.quote: Thirteen DSFGs were found to lie at redshifts $3.24 < z < 4.85$, shifting the ($1-0$) into ALMA Band 3.

question.value: What are the molecular gas masses and ISM physical conditions (density, UV field, temperature) of z~4 SPT dusty star-forming galaxies, as traced by [CI](1-0) and PDR modelling?

evidence.quote: Using the  line as a tracer of the molecular ISM, we find a mean molecular gas mass for SPT-DSFGs of $6.6 \times 10^{10}$ M$_{\ensuremath{\odot}}$.
26 SPT DSFGs were observed across the entirety of ALMA Band 3 ($= 84 - 116$ GHz) as part of the Cycle 0 ‘early compact array’ setup.

frequencies_and_spectral_setup.value: 5 tunings of 7.5 GHz each covering the band

evidence.quote: Each observation consisted of 5 distinct 7.5 GHz tunings, spaced to cover the band.

sensitivity.value: rms channel noise 2.1 mJy and 2.6 mJy per 50 km/s channel (SPT0300-46, SPT2103-60); 2.4 mJy for SPT0345-47

evidence.quote: which we measure to be 2.1 mJy and 2.6 mJy per 50 km/s channel respectively
Each source was observed for 120s in each tuning configuration.

other_facilities.name: APEX FLASH and Herschel SPIRE FTS

evidence.quote: The  observations were obtained from the APEX First Light APEX Submillimetre Heterodyne receiver (FLASH), and the Herschel ‘SPIRE’ FTS spectrometer.
The low-$J$ CO observations were taken by the Australia Telescope Compact Array (ATCA)

analysis_steps.goal: Derive atomic carbon and H2 masses

method.value: Weiss et al. 2005 carbon mass formula; Papadopoulos & Greve 2004 H2 mass formula

evidence.quote: (cite: papadopoulos04b) give an expression for calculating the total H$_2$ mass from the luminosity of the ($1-0$) line

analysis_steps.goal: Derive alpha_CO implied by [CI] gas masses

method.value: Ratio of M(H2)[CI] to L'CO(1-0), with CO(1-0) from CO(2-1) or higher-J via SLED

We assume a CO$(2-1)$/CO$(1-0)$ brightness temperature ratio of r$_{21/10} = 0.8$

analysis_steps.goal: PDR modelling of density, UV field, temperature

method.value: Grid of 3d-pdr 1D models; probability distributions from ratios [CII]/[CI], CO(4-3)/CO(2-1), [CI]/CO(4-3)

evidence.quote: we find probability density distributions for the mean density and the mean UV field strength for each galaxy, based on our grid of one-dimensional PDR models.

fitting.value: Peak of probability distribution over the grid

results_numeric.quantity: Mean log n with Kaufman99 models

findings_qualitative.value: SPT-DSFGs have dense gas with strong UV fields, denser than local ULIRGs and than found with Kaufman99 models.

evidence.quote: We find that the ISM within our DSFGs is characterised by dense gas permeated by strong UV fields.

claims.hypothesis: [CI]-based gas masses agree with CO- and dust-based masses under standard assumptions
claims.finding: Requires alpha_CO~2-2.4 and GDR~200, or X_CI~7e-5

evidence.quote: bringing the estimates into accordance requires either (a) an elevated CO-to-H$_2$ conversion factor for our sample of $\alpha_{\rm CO} \sim 2.5$

claims.hypothesis: Modern PDR models give different ISM conditions than older ones

evidence.quote: it seems that the gas density in these extreme high-$z$ objects may have been significantly underestimated.

claims.hypothesis: SPT-DSFGs differ in density from unlensed DSFGs
claims.experiment: 2D KS test on L[CI]/LFIR vs L[CI]/LCO(4-3)

evidence.quote: Performing a 2-dimensional Kolmogorov-Smirnov comparison between the (cite: AZ13) DSFGs and our SPT-DSFGs gives $p=0.061$

limitations_admitted.value: Cannot rule out AGN; Tex assumed; X_CI assumed; differential lensing possible

evidence.quote: Due to a lack of X-ray data for our sample we cannot rule out a possible AGN component in any of our 13 DSFGs.
